capabilities: copy link-target text to the clipboard on click
intercept only clip: links while normal links keep navigating
show clip: links in cyan to distinguish them
work in Reading View and Live Preview
disambiguation: Not a web clipper; 'clip:' links copy a fixed piece of text to the clipboard when clicked.
extras: Distributed as a beta plugin through BRAT and flagged as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; a Japanese version is mentioned ('日本語').
problem: Standard Obsidian links only navigate, so there is no built-in way to make a clickable link whose action is copying a snippet of text.
summary: Adds clip: Markdown links that copy their target text (phone numbers, emails, commands) to the clipboard with a single click.
